items.title: Billie Pierce and De De Pierce Interview, 1959-10-07
items.q: Yeah, I played with Buddy Manaday.

ctx.x: Let's see Duck Ernest play bass. I'm trying to think of who the different guys have played, you know, around with Buddy's gang. Uh, Buddy Manaday. Did you know him?
Buddy Manaday. What do you play, banjo? Buddy Manaday? Yeah, I played with Buddy Manaday. Buddy Manaday. Buddy Manaday. He ain't a slender, slender, slender fella, huh?
Well, I didn't know him. I definitely heard of him.
